page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated graphics processing. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, delivering 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it bundles a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, and network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the CPU and memory subsystems operate in lower performance tiers compared to modern hardware. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score of 953.38 falls into the bottom 10%, while the multi-core score of 4755.08 is in the bottom 25%. Similarly, memory bandwidth tests show weak results, with large-block read-only bandwidth at 37.18 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 25.34 GB/sec. PassMark CPU testing yields an average score of 6698.53, though extended instructions and encryption tests remain in the bottom 25%.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its reliance on older Intel Broadwell-generation CPU architecture and Pascal-generation GPU hardware, which limits its raw computational and memory throughput. However, from a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA P4 GPU makes it a viable entry-level option for GPU-accelerated tasks without the high cost of newer accelerator classes. This server is best suited for workloads such as light GPU-accelerated inference, legacy CUDA applications, basic video transcoding, and general-purpose tasks that require a dedicated GPU but do not demand high-performance CPU or memory bandwidth.
